name: UnSub ("Recon" agentic infostealer framework) — GTIG
description: An exposed C2 server hosted an automated reconnaissance and credential-management framework dubbed "Recon," with agentic config files (AGENTS.md, KNOWLEDGE.md) managing over 23,800 harvested secrets including cloud and AI API keys — which GTIG frames as a transition from passive, endpoint-focused infostealers to offensive agentic harvesting. GTIG
